profile_text.body:
Concentrix describes itself as a global technology and services leader that powers the world's best brands. Its site presents the company as combining technology with services, and it markets its iX Product Suite as artificial intelligence built by the people who run the underlying processes, understand why they fail, and know how to fix them. The company also describes enterprise-grade artificial intelligence and natural language processing as sharpening customer experience, operations, and the data behind both.

The site offers two customer examples. It says it transformed AI customer support for a toll road operator with a conversational chatbot solution, which it says improved containment and efficiency. It also describes work with Nespresso on digital optimization of customer and employee experiences through personalized AI transformation.

Concentrix is a public company. It trades under the ticker CNXC and has SEC CIK 0001803599.
